title: The best Relevance AI alternatives in 2026
summary: Relevance AI lets you build your own agents, but you build, not buy an outcome. Here are the best Relevance AI alternatives in 2026, ranked and honest.
body_markdown:
The right Relevance AI alternative depends on the work you want to delegate. For outbound sales, compare packaged sales products such as Artisan’s Ava. For a broader set of responsibilities across apps, compare AI employee products and agent platforms against the actual assignments your team needs to run.


Relevance AI offers specialist agents, customization and deployment support. The decision is how much configuration and ongoing ownership your team wants, which systems the work touches and how you will verify the result. The four-product shortlist below focuses on outbound sales.

## How we chose


Compare these products on four criteria: the work they cover, configuration and maintenance effort, the full cost at your expected usage, and the controls your team needs. Use the same sample workflow in demonstrations so a packaged sales tool and a configurable agent platform are not judged on unrelated features.


## Why do people look for a Relevance AI alternative?


Teams may look elsewhere because they need a narrower sales workflow, a different operating model or a better fit with their existing stack. Relevance AI offers specialist agents across several business functions and support for deployment and customization.


Ask who will own the workflow after launch. Check setup, integrations, testing, error handling and the work needed when a process changes. Relevance offers deployment support, so compare the actual implementation proposal with a packaged sales product instead of assuming every customer starts from a blank canvas.


## The four best Relevance AI alternatives in 2026


### 1. Artisan: A pre-built AI BDR you hire


Artisan is the alternative for teams that want to buy the outcome instead of building the agent. Ava, Artisan's AI BDR, focuses on a packaged outbound sales workflow. She sources best-fit leads from a database of over 250M B2B professionals in over 200 countries, plus Artisan Local Data with over 250M local businesses, runs waterfall email and phone enrichment across roughly a dozen providers charged only on success, and ranks leads by likelihood of converting. Then she writes personalized multichannel outreach across email, social media, and dialer steps, tests dozens of message variations, and shifts volume toward what converts.


The appeal is a sales workflow with its main components already packaged together. Ava handles every reply, qualifies, answers objections from a knowledge base, chases follow-ups, and books meetings on the right rep's calendar with CRM-owner routing, out of the box. Where Relevance gives you the flexibility to define behavior, Artisan gives you plain-language control over a system that already works. You define any custom buying signal in plain English and receive confidence scoring and evidence URLs on the results, set escalation rules the same way, and pick an autonomy level from review-and-approve to fully autonomous with a full audit trail. Over 90% of customers run her autonomously.


Compare the included deliverability, calling, signal and CRM capabilities against the workflow you need. You receive managed mailbox provisioning with automated sending ramp-up, a dialer billed separately at $75/seat/month when paid monthly, funding, hiring, and intent signals, and bidirectional Salesforce and HubSpot sync. For enterprises, Ava deploys centrally from sales ops with SOC 2 Type II attestation, single sign-on (SSO) and SAML on the Enterprise plan, and role-based access. Chain of Events, the team behind the RAISE Summit, sourced over $700K of annual recurring revenue (ARR) in six months with Ava, a 20x return on a $28K annual investment, without a team building an agent first. By CRM, see[the best AI SDR for HubSpot users](https://www.artisan.co/blog/the-best-ai-sdr-for-hubspot-users) and[the best AI SDR for Salesforce users](https://www.artisan.co/blog/the-best-ai-sdr-for-salesforce-users) .


-


**Best for:** teams from startup to enterprise that want a working AI BDR out of the box, configured in plain language


-


**Who should pick something else:** technical teams that specifically want to build and own a custom agent for non-sales workflows should keep Relevance


-


**Pricing:** usage-based credits for Ava's work, so you pay for the work she performs; dialer seats and phone numbers billed separately; free trial. See[pricing](https://www.artisan.co/pricing)


### 2. AiSDR: Transparent AI SDR pricing


AiSDR is a packaged AI SDR with pricing you can read before a demo, which makes it an easy step away from a build-it-yourself platform. It runs outbound and inbound through its Ami agent, sets up fast, and publishes tiers at $250, $900, and $2,500 a month. If you wanted a working sales agent instead of a builder, AiSDR gives you one without an engineering project.


The limits are scope and governance. AiSDR's center of gravity is small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) and the lower mid-market, and its enterprise story, meaning central deployment, deep audit, and security depth, is lighter than a large org needs. It is a good pick for a smaller team that wants an agent running outbound and inbound quickly, with none of Relevance's assembly.


-


**Best for:** SMB and lower mid-market teams that want a packaged agent with transparent pricing and quick setup


-


**Who should pick something else:** enterprises needing central ops deployment and deep governance should choose Artisan


-


**Pricing:** $250 to $2,500 a month, per its pricing page


### 3. Amplemarket: Data and engagement with a copilot


Amplemarket combines sales data and engagement with its Duo AI capabilities. Compare its research, outreach and review workflow against the responsibilities you want the system to take on, and request a quote for your expected usage.


Ask which actions run automatically, which stay with a rep and how exceptions are handled. Evaluate those boundaries directly rather than assuming that a product described as a copilot has a fixed level of autonomy.


-


**Best for:** teams that want a ready-made data and engagement platform with a copilot and strong signals


-


**Who should pick something else:** teams that want the motion run for them, not assisted, should look at Artisan


-


**Pricing:** around $600 a month at entry, per reporting; not publicly listed


### 4. Apollo: Value all-in-one


Apollo combines prospect data with sales engagement tools. Evaluate it when access to data and a shared outreach workflow are central to the requirement, then compare the plan’s credits, limits and integrations against your expected usage.


Use a real prospecting and outreach assignment to assess Apollo. Check data coverage, personalization, review steps and ongoing operator effort before deciding whether it covers enough of the job.


-


**Best for:** budget-conscious teams that want a proven all-in-one with data and sequencing and no build work


-


**Who should pick something else:** teams that want the outbound job executed autonomously should choose Artisan


-


**Pricing:** free tier up to roughly $119/user/month, per its pricing page


## What is the best enterprise alternative to Relevance AI?


For an enterprise outbound team, Artisan is a relevant option to evaluate for a packaged AI BDR workflow. Compare deployment support, access controls, auditability and CRM behavior across the products on your shortlist. Relevance also offers enterprise controls and deployment support, so governance should be checked against your requirements rather than inferred from the product category.


If the real requirement is a packaged agent for a smaller team instead of enterprise governance, AiSDR is the alternative worth a look.


## Stay with Relevance AI if...


Stay with Relevance AI if you want to customize specialist agents across several workflows and are prepared to own their ongoing operation. Discuss the deployment support, integrations and controls included in your proposal. The right choice depends on the work and ownership model, not simply on whether your team has engineers.


If the requirement extends beyond outbound, consider the AI employee category as well.[Artie](https://artie.ai/) is designed around ongoing responsibilities across apps and company context, including CRM data quality and customer onboarding. Compare that model with a customizable agent platform using one complete assignment: required sources, finished output, review effort and what happens when the work encounters an exception.


If the honest goal is a working outbound engine without a build project, an[AI sales agent](https://www.artisan.co/ai-sales-agent) that ships ready to run is the better buy. For the wider category, see our guide to[the best AI SDRs](https://www.artisan.co/blog/the-best-ai-sdrs) . You can also browse[the best AI BDRs](https://www.artisan.co/blog/the-best-ai-bdrs) ,[the best AI GTM platforms](https://www.artisan.co/blog/the-best-ai-gtm-platforms) , and[the 15 best AI sales tools](https://www.artisan.co/blog/the-best-ai-sales-tools) .


## Frequently asked questions


### What is the best alternative to Relevance AI?


For outbound sales, Artisan is one option to evaluate because Ava packages prospecting and outreach into a sales workflow. The best fit depends on your data, channels, review requirements and the amount of operational work your team can own.


### How is Artisan different from Relevance AI?


Artisan focuses on packaged sales workflows, while Relevance AI supports customized specialist agents across business functions. Compare the implementation effort and responsibility boundaries for your actual use case rather than treating either model as universally better.


### Is Relevance AI good for sales?


Relevance AI offers sales use cases including research, meeting preparation and outbound prospecting. Evaluate a representative workflow with the integrations, review rules and ongoing support your team needs, then compare the finished result with a purpose-built sales product.


### What is a cheaper alternative to Relevance AI?


Compare total cost at the same workload. Include software, actions or credits, data, implementation and operator time. Ask each provider for a current quote or plan breakdown for your sample workflow instead of comparing entry prices that cover different work.


### Do I need engineers to use Relevance AI?


Not necessarily. Relevance offers configuration and deployment support, but the team still needs someone responsible for the workflow, its inputs and its results. Ask the provider to demonstrate the setup and maintenance work that your own team would need to perform.


### What is the best enterprise alternative to Relevance AI?


Shortlist products against your enterprise requirements and test the same outbound workflow. For Artisan, assess Ava’s packaged sales process. For Relevance, assess the specialist agents and deployment proposal. Check permissions, audit records, integrations and exception handling directly in each evaluation.
